about: Migna's public record at this close: every company in the screened universe with its reading and its close, and every find with what it takes to recompute its move: when it was published, its entry (the next session's open), the day's open and close, its lowest close since entry, our estimate and band on its find day, the end of its judging clock, and the S&P 500 (SPY) over the same window. Fingerprinted nightly (record_fingerprint.py).
